description: Explicit documentation of Python-reference exceptions for non-native Rust operations

exceptions.rationale: Multi-generation Norton-Bass fitting requires complex state management and covariate-driven parameterization not yet implemented in native Rust. Single-generation fits are native, multi-generation falls back to Python bridge.
exceptions.fallback_diagnostic: Norton-Bass multi-generation fitting uses Python reference implementation. Performance will be impacted compared to single-generation native Rust fitting.
exceptions.revisit_condition: When native Rust implementation adds support for covariate-driven dynamic parameter fitting.
exceptions.scope: Only affects multi-generation Norton-Bass models; single-generation remains native.

exceptions.rationale: Composite diffusion models require complex model composition, kernel switching, and cross-model state management. These capabilities are not yet fully implemented in native Rust.
exceptions.fallback_diagnostic: Composite diffusion model operations use Python reference implementation. This is expected for early-stage model families.
exceptions.revisit_condition: When Rust implementation supports full model composition and kernel switching strategies.

exceptions.rationale: Multi-product competition models require complex market-share dynamics, cross-product interactions, and adaptive parameter fitting. Full native implementation is still under development.
exceptions.fallback_diagnostic: Multi-product competition models use Python reference implementation for full compatibility with market dynamics.
exceptions.revisit_condition: When Rust implementation completes market dynamics kernel and adaptive fitting.

exceptions.rationale: Network diffusion requires graph-based processing, neighbor computation, and network analytics. While discovery is native, fitting and simulation require graph processing capabilities being developed in Rust.
exceptions.fallback_diagnostic: Network diffusion operations use Python reference implementation with NetworkX backend.
exceptions.revisit_condition: When Rust implementation adds native graph processing and network analytics.

exceptions.rationale: Policy hazard models require hazard-based survival analysis, policy intervention tracking, and causal inference. These are advanced statistical capabilities under development in Rust.
exceptions.fallback_diagnostic: Policy hazard model operations use Python reference implementation.
exceptions.revisit_condition: When Rust implementation adds survival analysis and causal inference kernels.

exception_audit_log.notes: All exceptions are documented per Track 02 requirements. Each exception has owner, rationale, fallback diagnostic, and revisit condition. No undocumented fallbacks exist.
